name: emg2qwerty-p11-01
title: Wrist sEMG typing (emg2qwerty): causal ring-TCN CTC decoder, generic model (P11-01) - RESEARCH ONLY
task: continuous EMG-to-text, CTC over 95 printable ASCII characters + Backspace + Enter

input.features: log band power: 64-sample Hann windows every 20 samples (100 frames/s), 12 bands, fixed normalisation
input.file_note: one emg2qwerty session *.hdf5; one stream per text prompt (needs h5py)

licence.weights_status: research only; never in the wheel; a separate opt-in download after P14-02; the weights keep the share-alike terms
licence.attribution: Data: emg2qwerty (Sivakumar et al., Meta, 2024), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (repository LICENSE file; the README says CC BY-NC 4.0; we follow the stricter one)

training.data: emg2qwerty, generic-train sessions (users other than the 8 test users)
training.split: prep.py make_splits, salt fidetype-p11-01-2026-11-16 (8 test users; generic train on the other users)

metrics.name: greedy CER (no LM)
metrics.split: test sessions of the 8 test users (pooled, 71,476 keys)

limits: Generic model: a new user gets CER about 0.54. The personalised models of P11-01 (CER 0.151) are per test user and not in this release.
trust_note: No committed EMG trust config yet (P11-09 builds it).

hosting.notes: no download URL yet; research-only weights need a separate opt-in host and a licence acceptance step (P14-02)
